title: PR drafting validates a lean handoff and renders four focused sections

provenance.originSummary: Synthetic benchmark for the streamlined schema and presentation contract.
provenance.whyItMattered: The shortcut needs a small validation gate without carrying audit-only repository, search, or policy state through every model iteration.
provenance.genericCondition: One sanitized run supplies a complete schema-version 2.0 payload; invalid runs omit one of the six lean fields.

description: A valid payload renders exactly four ordered sections and the footer; an invalid payload emits only the schema hard stop.

scope.notes: The valid run models one existing Resource enhancement with matching tests and docs.

mustCatch.description: A payload missing any lean required property hard-stops before partial output.
A valid payload contains only schemaVersion, repository, title, whyThisTitle, draftBody, and evidenceNotes.
The repository object records worktree root, branch, full HEAD, local base reference, and merge base.
A valid payload renders Suggested PR Title, Why This Title, Draft PR Body, and Evidence Notes in order.
The complete body appears in one Markdown code block without process or search sections.
The exact preflight and skill lines are final.
Template prose, URLs, comments, headings, checklist text, Community Note content, rollback text, and the final note remain byte-for-byte unchanged outside designated populated areas.

mustNotFlag.description: A schema-invalid handoff must not emit partial output.
The lean payload must not require fingerprints, restart counts, pull request discovery, candidate searches, checklist records, or changelog records.
The normal response must not add alternate titles, orchestration notes, or potential issue sections.
The drafting workflow must not shorten, normalize, or otherwise rewrite a URL copied from the current pull request template.

mustIncludeMarkers: Cannot run draft-pr-description: pr-description produced a schema-invalid draft payload. Refresh the workflow files and re-run this prompt.

notes: The paired Markdown example captures the streamlined valid output shape.
